{{Quote|The ''plans'', secure are they?''"<br />"''We lost the droid that contained them, Master. Ventress saw to that.|[[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="Hunted (comic)">{{TCWComicCite|6.16|Hunted (comic story)}}</ref>}}
The '''hypermatter generators''' were a series of devices used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] uncovered their coordinates during the war, only to have the [[J-3PO|droid]] storing them [[Mission to Asuin|destroyed]] at [[Asuin]].
